classification.difficultyReason: Convert the table diameter to centimetres, find its radius and add the overhang before calculating the tablecloth area.

content.prompt: Meredith has a circular table with diameter $1.2\text{ m}$. What is the approximate area of a circular tablecloth that would cover the table and have $5\text{ cm}$ hanging over the edge? Use $\pi\approx3.14$.

answer.short:
$13266.5\text{ cm}^2$

Add the overhang to the table’s radius before using $A=\pi r^2$.
answer.worked:
The overhang increases the radius by $5\text{ cm}$.
$$\begin{align*}\text{Table diameter}&=1.2\times100=120\text{ cm}\\\text{Table radius}&=120\div2=60\text{ cm}\\\text{Tablecloth radius}&=60+5=65\text{ cm}\\A&=\pi r^2\\A&\approx3.14\times65^2\\A&\approx13266.5\text{ cm}^2\end{align*}$$
